n = 13
k = 6  # degree
# circulant graph: connect i to i+1, i+2, i+3 mod n
edges = set()
for i in range(n):
    for d in range(1, k//2 + 1):  # distances 1,2,3
        j = (i + d) % n
        if i < j:
            edges.add((i, j))
        else:
            edges.add((j, i))
print("Number of edges:", len(edges))
# verify degrees
deg = [0]*n
for u,v in edges:
    deg[u] += 1
    deg[v] += 1
print("Degrees:", deg)
print("Min degree:", min(deg))
print("Edges:", sorted(edges))
